tw: Kron shifts gear, and his car jumps clear of the pier as the deer cheer.
twc: Kron 一换挡，小车飞出码头，几只鹿在岸上欢呼。

tw: In a brave endeavour, Kron blows one feather up for seven hours, never letting it fall.
twc: Kron 勇敢尝试：连吹七小时，羽毛一次都没掉下来。
hint: 努力到灵魂都吹出去了。

tw: The fat cat keeps the status quo: it sat on Kron's toe and won't go.
twc: 肥猫要维持现状：坐在 Kron 脚趾上就是不走。

tw: Public servant Kron serves the ants at the pub, and every ant licks the tub.
twc: 公仆 Kron 在小酒馆为蚂蚁服务，每只蚂蚁都舔果酱桶。

tw: Kron will put his pie on the line in a tug of war with nine swine.
twc: Kron 拿自己的馅饼当赌注，和九头猪拔河。
hint: 赌上馅饼，对手是九头猪。

tw: Kron does detective work on the deck, checking every fork for a tiny speck.
twc: Kron 在甲板上搞侦查，一把把叉子查有没有小斑点。

tw: Kron lays the groundwork for a round hound house, and the hound does no work.
twc: Kron 给圆狗屋打地基，狗一点活也不干。
hint: 打地基的是他，躺着的是狗。

tw: Kron pours porridge in proportion: a portion for Kron, an ocean for the hippo.
twc: Kron 按比例倒粥：自己一小份，河马一片海。
hint: 按比例分，他只配一小勺。

tw: When the king's swing snaps, watch Kron swing into action and land in a fashion pose.
twc: 国王的秋千一断，Kron 立刻出动，摆着时装造型落地。

tw: At supper, Kron tries to gain the upper hand, but a puppy's paw lands on top.
twc: 晚饭时 Kron 想占上风，小狗一爪子拍在最上面。
hint: 以为赢了，上面还有狗爪。

tw: Kron tells the mice concisely, "Nice try," and holds his ice cone high.
twc: Kron 简单一句告诉老鼠们：“想得美。”冰淇淋举得高高的。

tw: Kron feels refreshed after a splash, but his quills are a fresh fish mess.
twc: Kron 泡了个澡觉得神清气爽，可刺上挂满了鲜鱼。

tw: For the duration of the rain, Kron shares a snail's tiny umbrella at the station.
twc: 下雨的整段时间，Kron 在车站和蜗牛挤一把小伞。

tw: At dawn on the lawn, Kron's yawn is so big a fawn peeks in.
twc: 清晨草坪上，Kron 打了个超大哈欠，一只小鹿探头往里看。

tw: In his best vest, Kron will put his best foot forward on the wet wood floor.
twc: Kron 穿上最好的背心全力以赴，一脚踩上湿木地板。

tw: Kron's auditory test: an otter taps a story on a door, and Kron hears "paw, paw".
twc: Kron 做听力测试：水獭敲门讲故事，他只听到“爪，爪”。

tw: Kron has a verbal fight with a purple bird: "Fur ball!" "Feather ball!"
twc: Kron 和紫鸟吵嘴：“毛球！”“羽毛球！”

tw: Kron tries to keep pace with a sheep in a race, red in the face.
twc: Kron 赛跑时想跟上一只羊，跑得满脸通红。

tw: Kron likes to criticize the kitten's ties, so the kitten sits on his eyes.
twc: Kron 爱批评小猫的领带，小猫就坐到他眼睛上。

tw: An elf on a shelf tells Kron his self-worth is worth more than the earth.
twc: 架子上的小精灵告诉 Kron：他的价值比地球还大。
